title: I spent countless nights digging into PHP2Shell. Here's a deep dive into how it actually works, from memory to PHP internals to a real exploit.
description: This content is a detailed technical research and analysis of the PHP2Shell vulnerabilities, focusing on memory corruption issues such as use-after-free (UAF) and stale pointers within PHP internals. The author provides an in-depth walkthrough from basic memory concepts to the actual exploit code, aiming to clarify how these vulnerabilities lead to remote code execution (RCE). The research is based on personal experiments and source code analysis rather than an official advisory. No specific affected versions or patch information are provided.
